Get route speed

Source: R/get_route_speed.R
get_route_speed.Rd

Returns summary statistics of the average speeds of the trips of each specified route_id.

Usage

get_route_speed(
  gtfs,
  route_id = NULL,
  method = "shapes",
  unit = "km/h",
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL
)

Arguments

gtfs

A GTFS object, as created by read_gtfs().

route_id

A character vector including the route_ids to have their speeds summarised. If NULL (the default), the function summarises the speeds of every route_id in the GTFS. route_ids not listed in trips are ignored, with a warning.

method

A string, either "shapes" (the default) or "euclidean". "shapes" measures lengths along the trip's shape, described in the shapes table, while "euclidean" measures the straight-line (great-circle) distances between consecutive stops. If the GTFS object doesn't have a shapes table, or if its trips table doesn't have a shape_id column, "euclidean" is used instead, with a warning.

unit

A string representing the unit in which the speeds are desired. One of "km/h" (the default), "m/s" or "mph" (miles per hour).

from

A string, in the "HH:MM:SS" format. Only trips that depart from their first stop at or after from are included. If NULL (the default), there is no lower limit.

to

A string, in the "HH:MM:SS" format. Only trips that depart from their first stop at or before to are included. If NULL (the default), there is no upper limit.

Value

A data.table with the route_id and the minimum (min_speed), mean (mean_speed), median (median_speed), maximum (max_speed) and standard deviation (sd_speed) of the speeds of its trips, ordered by route_id.

Details

The speed of each trip is calculated with get_trip_speed() (with by = "trip"), whose details also apply here. Each trip is linked to its route by the trips table. mean_speed is the unweighted mean of the trip speeds, not the total length of the trips divided by their total duration. Trips listed in frequencies count once, regardless of their headways.

Trips with NA speeds are ignored. Routes whose trips all have NA speeds get NA statistics, and sd_speed is NA for routes with a single trip with a known speed. Routes without any trip in stop_times (or, if from or to is given, without any trip departing within the time of day) are not returned.

See also

get_trip_speed(), set_route_speed(), set_trip_speed()

Examples

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo_gtfs.zip", package = "gtfstools")

gtfs <- read_gtfs(data_path)

route_speed <- get_route_speed(gtfs)
head(route_speed)
#>    route_id min_speed mean_speed median_speed max_speed  sd_speed
#>      <char>     <num>      <num>        <num>     <num>     <num>
#> 1:  2002-10  8.360838   8.360838     8.360838  8.360838        NA
#> 2:  2105-10  9.651135   9.951090     9.951090 10.251044 0.4241997
#> 3:  2161-10 11.172445  11.398943    11.398943 11.625440 0.3203161
#> 4:  4491-10 12.011979  13.585046    13.585046 15.158114 2.2246538
#> 5:  5290-10  9.103782   9.870054     9.870054 10.636326 1.0836719
#> 6:  6450-51 11.450417  11.450417    11.450417 11.450417        NA

route_ids <- c("CPTM L07", "2002-10")
route_speed <- get_route_speed(gtfs, route_ids)
route_speed
#>    route_id min_speed mean_speed median_speed max_speed     sd_speed
#>      <char>     <num>      <num>        <num>     <num>        <num>
#> 1:  2002-10  8.360838   8.360838     8.360838  8.360838           NA
#> 2: CPTM L07 26.730015  26.730015    26.730015 26.730015 7.944109e-15

route_speed <- get_route_speed(gtfs, route_ids, method = "euclidean")
route_speed
#>    route_id min_speed mean_speed median_speed max_speed     sd_speed
#>      <char>     <num>      <num>        <num>     <num>        <num>
#> 1:  2002-10  6.559614   6.559614     6.559614  6.559614           NA
#> 2: CPTM L07 24.342591  24.342591    24.342591 24.342591 3.552714e-15

route_speed <- get_route_speed(gtfs, route_ids, unit = "m/s")
route_speed
#>    route_id min_speed mean_speed median_speed max_speed     sd_speed
#>      <char>     <num>      <num>        <num>     <num>        <num>
#> 1:  2002-10  2.322455   2.322455     2.322455  2.322455           NA
#> 2: CPTM L07  7.425004   7.425004     7.425004  7.425004 2.512148e-15
